content: Yahoo v8 chart endpoint supports interval=60m/1h intraday; intraday granularity limited to last ~60 days (1m limited to ~7d per request). Range/period params (range=5d, interval as query) work the same for futures symbols such as ES=F as for NQ=F; same path pattern /v8/finance/chart/<SYM> with period1/period2 or range.
